newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's share index drops 14.76 points in week.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's share index drops 14.76 points in week.

text.p: Bahrain's official share index fell 14.76 points this week in active trade focused on bank shares, Bahrain Stock Exchange (BSE) figures showed.
The 1,000-point index dropped to 1,531.27 points in the week ending on Thursday from 1,546.03 points the previous week.
Trading volume soared to 9.9 million shares worth 2.86 million dinars ($7.6 million) from 2.9 million shares worth 1.1 million dinars a week earlier.
More than 4.2 million shares worth 1.2 million dinars were traded on Thursday alone.
Shares of 24 firms out of 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 242 transactions, the exchange said.

Al-Ahli Commercial Bank shares led the market with 3.9 million shares worth 1.24 million dinars traded, followed by Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait with 2.1 million shares worth 423,441 dinars changing hands.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Some firms are also open to foreign investors.
